plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: Ralph autonomous agent loop for ZCode: generate a PRD, convert it to prd.json user stories, then let each fresh-context iteration implement exactly one story, run the project's checks, commit, and append learnings to progress.txt

description_i18n.en: Generate a PRD, convert it to prd.json, then run one fresh-context iteration per story until everything passes
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成 PRD、转成 prd.json，然后每轮一个新上下文迭代实现一个故事并提交，直到全部通过
